title: Solvable models of learning to pursue a moving target
abstract: arXiv:2610.30721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents tasked with intercepting a moving target must learn how to reach it, ideally as efficiently as possible. As observers of animal pursuit behavior have noticed, different strategies are possible: on one extreme, the agent reactively moves toward the target's current location; on the other, the agent predicts the target's future location and moves directly there. Motivated by the desire to understand how such strategies might be learned, we introduce a continuous-time linear-quadratic model of open-loop target pursuit whose optimal control strategies interpolate between these possibilities. Usefully, a small number of interpretable parameters control which type of strategy is optimal, and it is possible to derive closed-form solutions for optimal strategies, policy learning dynamics, and value learning dynamics. translated_title: 学习追捕移动目标的可解模型
translated_abstract: 被赋予拦截移动目标任务的智能体必须学习如何到达目标，理想情况下应尽可能高效。正如对动物追捕行为的观察者所注意到的，存在多种可能的策略：一个极端是，智能体反应式地朝目标的当前位置移动；另一个极端是，智能体预测目标的未来位置并直接朝那里移动。出于理解这类策略如何被学习的动机，我们引入了一个开环目标追捕的连续时间线性二次模型，其最优控制策略可以在上述两种可能性之间进行插值。有用的是，少量可解释的参数即可控制哪种类型的策略是最优的，并且可以为最优策略、策略学习动力学和价值学习动力学推导出闭式解。利用模型的线性结构，我们发现学习的时间尺度精确对应于特征值……
tldr: 提出了一个可解析求解的连续时间线性二次追捕模型，其最优控制策略可在反应式与预测式追捕之间插值，并给出了最优策略与学习动力学的闭式解，学习时间尺度由特征值精确刻画。
en_tdlr: We introduce a solvable continuous-time linear-quadratic model of learning to pursue a moving target, whose optimal control strategies interpolate between reactive and predictive pursuit, with closed-form solutions for optimal strategies and learning dynamics whose time scales correspond to eigenvalues.
